## We are board-certified vascular specialists dedicated to treatment of the body’s arteries and
## veins.

Whether you need treatment for a chronic vascular condition or you just want your legs to look their
very best, our team of experts is here to help.

## **Did You Know?**

### At Vascular Specialists of Central Florida, our vascular specialists, clinical staff and
### administrative staff are highly trained and able to assist you throughout every aspect of your
### vascular care.

# ** Always Wanted**

Sclerotherapy is the procedure used to treat unwanted small vessels,
called spider veins, usually found on the thighs and calves.

[Learn More About Sclerotherapy][44]

# **A 15 Minute Screening**** Could Save Your Life**

Early vascular disease detection can significantly reduce the risks of subsequent disability and
death from vascular disease.

[View Screening Packages][45]

#### About Our Practice

[[Vascular 30Y ear GoldLogo][Vascular 30Y ear GoldLogo]][46]Vascular Specialists of Central Florida
(VSCF), Inc. is a single specialty group of Vascular Specialists, solely dedicated to the treatment
of the body’s arteries and veins. We strive to serve our patients as unique human beings, providing
them with the highest quality care in vascular health. We specialize in vascular surgery, vascular
medicine, endovascular surgery, and vascular imaging.

## [ Pre-Clinical Imaging Agents ][14]

BioPAL is a leading provider of quality MRI contrast reagents to the life-science community. We
offer a wide range of iron-base (T2 imaging agent, USPIOs) and gadolinium-based (T1 imaging agent)
contrast reagents. BioPAL also provides and developes products for other imaging systems, such as
optical (near infrared), nuclear imaging and CT.

## [ Kidney Diagnostics ][15]

Immunoassay kits to measure glomerular filtration rate (GFR) and to measure effective renal blood
flow (RBF). FIT-GFR kits are available to measure the clearance of inulin, iohexol, Gd-DTPA or
Gd-DOTA. FIT-RBF kit is available to measure the clearance of iodohippurate.

## [ Microspheres for Blood Flow Studies ][16]

BioPAL offers stable-isotope labeled microspheres, which is a cost-effective alternative to the use
of radioactive and optical microspheres for the measurement of regional organ blood flow and
particle deposition studies. Twelve different labels of microspheres are available.

## [ Dead-Cell Removal Kits - Viahance™ ][17]

Viahance dead-cell removal kit is the ONLY product on the market that can simultaneously remove dead
cells, stripped nuclei and free oligonucleotides from cell culture. This product is also the ONLY
product on the market that is provided autoclaved and does not contain foreign proteins, such as
Annexin-V.

## [ Products for Cellular Therapy Research ][18]

Innovative life science products to aid researchers developing novel cellular-based products to
study and treat disease. Dead cell and nucleic acid purification product for cell culture
preparations and ready-to-use cell labeling and tracking products for the evaluation of cell

## Innovation. Quality. Trust.

**Carestream is a vibrant global company with a proven history of superb imaging technology and
unparalleled service.**

That history is now poised to continue, creating imaging solutions that provide our customers with

Enables customers to lower radiation dose without loss in image quality. Performance validated in an
internal study with **50%** dose reduction from 220 IEC EI on average.*

* These statements were validated using Carestream CsI detectors in reader studies conducted by
board-certified radiologists. Pairwise comparisons were performed between images at nominal exposure
dose without SNC and at 50% reduced dose with SNC. The reduced-dose images included live patient
images with simulated dose reduction, as well as images of human cadavers and anthropomorphic
phantoms obtained using actual reduced-dose X-ray exposures. SNC performance was further confirmed
using a CDRAD phantom. IEC EI values on average at nominal and reduced dose were 220 and 110,
respectively.

# Meet Christie Medical

Christie Medical Holdings, Inc. is a global company based in central Florida. A dedicated
trailblazer to Illuminating Revolutionary Patient Care™, Christie Medical proudly creates and
commercializes products for the healthcare industry. Its high-standing reputation has stood the test
of time, because Christie has been recognized as a MedTech Development Company of the Year (USA)
many times and VeinViewer® was voted **“[Best Mobile Vascular Imaging System][48]” by Global Health
& Pharma**.

*Christie is behind medical innovations that have paved the way towards better vascular access and
an improved patient experience. With the future always in mind, Christie is continually creating new
products and developing their existing ones through extensive research. **Learn more about
VeinViewer^{®} [Vision2][49] and [Flex][50]. ***

# Christie Medical is committed to
* #### Improving the patient experience
* #### Lowering the cost of care
* #### Minimizing patient risk
* #### Developing quality products

[Best Vein Finder][51]

# A Background on NIR Vascular Imaging Technologies

Near-infrared vascular imaging technology was first discovered almost thirty years ago. Shortly
after, the earliest model of VeinViewer® was developed and later deemed one of Time Magazine’s “Most
Amazing Inventions of 2004.” While trying to devise a device to assist the visually impaired, the
original inventor realized VeinViewer could distinguish blood vessels from surrounding tissue.
Prototypes ensued with several iterations as technology advanced leading to today’s smart VeinViewer
models.

Six device generations later and a global footprint of 40+ countries and counting, the VeinViewer®
has been revolutionary to the patient and practitioner experience since it’s invention.

# Navigate with CathCompass

CathCompass™ uses the unparalleled NIR technology by VeinViewer® to illuminate patients’ veins with
a built- in color-coded, peripheral IV catheter sizing reference graphic. Exclusive to the
VeinViewer® Flex and Vision2 models, CathCompass™ supports clinicians in the pre-, during, and
post-procedure vascular evaluation process.

[Explore CathCompass][52]

How It Works

## From day one to full operations in days.

01

### Connect your EHR

clinIQ sits on top of your existing EHR — no replacement, no data migration. We connect in hours.

02

### Configure for your specialty

We set up your patient flow rules, room assignments, RTM eligibility criteria, and pre-auth payer
list.

03

### Patients check in digitally

Patients get a text before arrival. They complete intake, insurance, and consent on their phone.

04

### Staff sees live patient flow

Every provider, room, and patient status is visible in real time. No walkie-talkies needed.

05

### RTM and billing run automatically

clinIQ flags RTM-eligible patients, tracks compliance minutes, and routes billing codes —
hands-free.

The Problem

## Your EHR records care. It doesn't run your clinic.

EHRs are built for documentation and billing. They were never designed to manage patient flow,
coordinate real-time room status, or automate RTM compliance. clinIQ fills that gap.

### Whiteboards still running patient tracking

Erasable and invisible to anyone not in the room. One nurse's absence and the whole system breaks.

### Check-in lines backing up at 9am

Paper clipboards, front desk bottlenecks, insurance verification that takes 7 minutes per patient.

### RTM revenue sitting uncollected

You're probably eligible for CPT 98975–98981 billing right now. Without automation, you're not
capturing it.

### Pre-auth denials arriving after the appointment

Manual prior auth means approvals come after the visit — leaving revenue on the table and patients
frustrated.

### No visibility into what's actually slowing you down

You know things feel slow, but you can't see which provider, room, or step is the actual bottleneck.

[See how clinIQ fixes this][77][See How It Works][78]

## Comfort, Compassion, and Care—At Home

Providing a peaceful and dignified experience for your cherished companions within the sanctuary of
home.

[505-615-2418][1]

Monday - Saturday

10 am - 5:30 pm

Servicing: Albuquerque, Rio Rancho, East Mountains, Cedar Crest, Tijeras, Placitas, Bosque Farms,
Los Lunas, and Belen. *Travel fees may apply.

Services

### Private Cremation

$600 - Includes all services of the In-Home Euthanasia and the pet's ashes are returned.

### Communal Cremation

$525 - Includes all services of the In-Home Euthanasia but the pet's ashes are not returned.

### In-Home Euthanasia

$400 - At home burial: Includes a brief discussion with the veterinarian, a sedation cocktail (for
pain control, anxiety relief, and anesthesia), and euthanasia. Making a paw print and clipping a
lock of fur included. Frame included for paw print.

Taxes and possible travel fee may apply. Please call, text or email for more information.

Additional Services

### Pet Loss Support

We provide gentle guidance and resources to support you after a difficult loss.

### In-Home Ultrasound Imaging

Bring advanced diagnostic care directly to your pet in the comfort of home. Our in-home ultrasound
service provides a safe, convenient, and low-stress way to evaluate your pet's abdomen or heart
without the need to travel to a clinic. Sedation is also available if needed.

### Hospice & Quality-of-Life Evaluation

$200 – Includes an examination by the doctor, a thorough discussion about your pet’s quality of life
and what to expect as their condition progresses. You’ll also receive an email summary of the visit,
sent to you and your regular veterinarian. 50% of this payment can be used for follow-on services
within 7 days.

## In-home Ultrasound Imaging

Experience high-end diagnostic technology without leaving your house, ensuring a tranquil atmosphere
for your loved ones. Our on-site imaging provides deep medical insights while avoiding the anxiety
of clinical visits and transportation. Every session is finalized with a professional analysis from
board-certified specialists to ensure the highest standard of health evaluation for your animal
family members. For more information please visit

[https://www.ultrasoundpaws.com][3]

## Healing In Heartfelt Peace

Navigating the loss of a cherished companion is a journey that requires tender care. We provide
thoughtful resources and a compassionate network to guide you through grief with clinical dignity
and emotional peace.

Locally owned and operated
